name: Makar
overview: Makar is a successful children's rapper. Bad boy, who achieved everything "on his own". During an interview about his career and successful life, he tells how he came to this. The plot is built around flashbacks, as it was. The young hero tries himself in different genres, various challenges and parody clips. As a result, he finds his own style and leads a narrative about the past from the height of his achievements.
